name: English crisis seed stems (Tier-3) for transfer code-mix generation
provenance: Curated/paraphrased short first-person English crisis statements written in a clinical register for the purpose of transfer code-mix generation (design Part 1.3 §5/D1). NO scraped private posts, NO real user data — every stem is a generic, paraphrased clinical-style sentence. This file is the offline, auditable stand-in for the Agarwal & Dhingra (2021) English-crisis transfer source (SuicideWatch); the neural Gupta-2020 transfer route over a large scraped corpus is the documented scale-up path. Versioned so it can be audited and cited.
notes: Each stem is a short first-person English crisis statement. The generator (Part 1.3 Step 3) transliterates anchor clinical terms to their Hinglish equivalents from lexicon_mh_v1.json and code-mix-inserts romanized Hindi function words using fixed sentence frames. Generation is deterministic (seeded). These stems are training-data sources only and are never user-facing.
ethics: Tier-3 is rare and ethically sensitive. This seed contains no identifying content, no method/means detail, and no scraped material; it exists solely to manufacture balanced training text offline under principle P1 (no human in the loop) so a classifier can learn to DETECT crisis language. It is not generative user-facing content.
